summary: Stage 3 fair-use WORDING/UI check (no AI calls made, no Lex messages sent, no settings changed). Backend: /api/subscription/tiers and /api/topups/packs now return the approved wording (9/9 pytest pass). In-app: the upgrade modal (desktop 1920 and mobile 390) shows the new Free/Plus/Pro/Yearly wording with the existing styling and no horizontal overflow. The one-time top-ups tab shows the new taglines. The free user's Ask Lex panel shows '2 of 2 free Lex questions left.' The admin 'Fair use & spending' card renders. terms.html has 6c Fair use between 6b and 7. BLOCKER: the real public pricing page is /welcome.html, where every logged-out visitor to '/' is redirected, and it still shows the old wording: '5 Lex chats / day', 'Unlimited Lex chats', 'Unlimited letters', 'Fair use: up to 100 Lex chats a day on Plus', plus old JSON-LD/FAQ copy. MarketingSite.jsx was updated correctly but nothing imports or routes it, so /pricing and /terms do not render it and the edit has no visible effect.

minor.issue: Customer-facing welcome email still says 'Lex chat with daily limits' (Free) and 'Plus, £19.99/month: unlimited Lex chat'. Needs the approved wording.

These are the Terms users must accept at onboarding. They contain no Fair use clause. Only terms.html, the App.js settings TOS and MarketingSite TOS got 6c. Owner should decide whether the acceptance Terms need it too.
The legacy 'usage.lex_chat' still reports limit 5 / daily for free users, next to fair_use.free_actions limit 2 lifetime. The UI does not show it today, but API consumers could be confused.

ui_bugs.component: public/welcome.html pricing section (L660-710), JSON-LD offers (L97, L133), FAQ (L809-823), taster status text (L909)
ui_bugs.issue: Old customer-facing wording still live on the public landing/pricing page: Free '5 Lex chats / day', '1 letter / month'; Plus 'Unlimited Lex chats*', 'Unlimited letters'; footnote 'Fair use: up to 100 Lex chats a day on Plus'; FAQ 'then get 5 Lex chats a day on the free plan'; taster message 'Create a free account for 5 Lex chats a day.' Plus also contradicts the new 20 letters/month cap.

The file is not imported anywhere (grep finds no import of MarketingSite/PricingPage). /pricing and /terms load the main SPA with the cookie banner. The updated pricing bullets and TOS 6c are not reachable by users.

TOS text is rendered as raw text with whiteSpace pre-wrap, so '**6c. Fair use.**' shows literal asterisks and '# Terms of Service' shows a literal '#'. This was already true for all sections before this change, but the request expected a bold heading.
Shows 'Valid for 0h after purchase.' while the tagline says 'Never expires'. duration_hours=0 is not handled in App.js ~L8369.

issues: Numbering jumps 6 > 6c > 7; there is no 6a/6b in this copy (they exist in terms.html). This reads oddly. Consider numbering it 6a or adding the missing sections.

critical_code_review_comments: Three separate Terms texts (terms.html, App.js TOS_TEXT/MarketingSite TOS, server TERMS_BODY_EN) have drifted apart: different numbering and different clauses. Pick one source of truth.
Plan wording is duplicated across server.py tiers, MarketingSite.jsx, welcome.html, email_helper.py and i18n JSON. Driving the static pages from /api/subscription/tiers would prevent this drift.
App.js is more than 17k lines; it should be split.
